integrity: Analytic infinite-family proof through Schur complements, rank-one trace updates, strict class dominance, and a quadratic sign analysis; exact finite rational reproduction in verify.py. Scientific literature comparisons are qualified and independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Exactly two noise-free leaders, K_{p,q} with p>=3 and p<=q, unit cross edges, one positive intrapart edge and inverse-grounded-Laplacian trace; no results on larger budgets, multiple chords, alternative dynamics, or independently established publication priority.
title: A sharp conductance-driven switch of optimal two-leader placement in a one-chord biclique
